technique: Asynchronous L2 prefetch (cp.async.bulk.prefetch.L2) of the block scales (one span per gate/up half at block start) and of the packed fp4 weights (two 64-byte units per row, two groups ahead) in the gate/up GEMM of the w4a16 grouped MoE kernel, with a 64-row tile, for chunks of up to 64 pairs per expert.
mechanism: At 1k-2k tokens per chunk each expert has 32-64 rows and the kernel is bound by the DRAM read of the expert weights (2.7 of 2.9 ms with compute removed) which the 64-byte cp.async units draw at only 200-212 GB/s of 273; bulk prefetch keeps more reads in flight without using shared memory or registers. No arithmetic or accumulation order changes.
impact: Kernel -7 % at 1k, -4 % at 2k tokens (uniform routing; -10 % / -5 % skewed). 35B prefill tok/s vs main with lt on, localeval x3 interleaved, same-window vLLM: 1k +7 %, 4k +1 %, 16k +0.6 to +4 %.
preconditions: chunk of at most 2048 tokens at 256 experts top-8 (cap 64 pairs per expert)
transfer_notes: Bitwise the default kernel. Above the cap (chunk 4096 and 8192) the knob is a no-op; the down GEMM and the combine kernel are not helped.
